_comment: Photos and videos for the site. Originals live in media-src/ (gitignored, never committed). Run `python3 scripts/media.py` to encode anything new; it fills in src, poster, width, height, duration and bytes. Then `python3 src/build.py`. Every output is stripped of metadata (GPS included). kind: photo | drone | thermal | work | trailcam. home: true puts a video on the home page.

items.title: Fitz at sunset
items.caption: Fitz on a Gippsland hillside at sunset.
items.alt: Robert Fitzgerald in a cap and olive fleece with binoculars, standing beside a spotting scope on a tripod and looking out over Gippsland hill country at sunset.

items.title: Thermal rig on the tripod at dusk
items.caption: Rifle and thermal scope setup.
items.alt: A wooden-stocked rifle with a thermal scope mounted on a tripod beside a cream four-wheel drive with a roof rack, green paddock and a dusk sky behind.

items.title: Fitz working
items.caption: Fitz working.
items.alt: Fitz in a cap and a dark green oilskin coat aiming a scoped rifle off shooting sticks among tall eucalypts, leaf litter underfoot.

items.title: Thermal monocular view
items.caption: Thermal monocular used to spot deer on the hill.
items.alt: Thermal monocular view in grey, with four deer showing hot in orange and yellow on a hillside and the readout across the top.

items.title: Gippsland hills at first light
items.caption: Frosty hill country at first light, from the drone.
items.alt: Aerial view at dawn of frost-covered rolling green paddocks, a gully of trees and a tree line in autumn colour.

items.title: Thermal drone: finding the mob
items.caption: From the thermal drone: a mob picked up on an open hillside and followed into the timber, before anyone walks in.
items.description: Black-and-white thermal footage from a drone flying over a hillside at night. Several animals show as bright white shapes, first in the open and then moving through scattered trees.

items.title: Stock identified on thermal
items.caption: The landholder's cattle, clearly identified on thermal. Stock is checked and the line confirmed clear before any work starts.
items.description: Thermal footage through a round eyepiece of two cattle grazing on a dark paddock, their bodies showing white and warm spots in yellow and orange, with the device's readout along the bottom.

items.title: Fallow deer on a hillside paddock
items.caption: A mob of fallow deer moving up a steep paddock. Numbers like this are why landholders call.
items.description: Phone video, filmed upright, of a large mob of fallow deer in mixed colours running up a steep green hillside under a grey sky, past a fence line.

items.title: Deer crossing the hill
items.caption: A line of deer working across open hill country, spotted from the tree line below.
items.description: Phone video, filmed upright, of a line of deer walking across a steep grassy hillside under a blue sky, with eucalypts in the foreground.

items.title: Stag on the trail camera before dawn
items.caption: Trail cameras show what moves through and when. This stag came past at 5:58 am.
items.description: Black-and-white night footage from a trail camera on a bush track. An antlered stag walks across close to the camera and out of frame.

items.title: First light from the drone
items.caption: A dawn flight over hill country: deer picked out in the paddock from the air, then the gullies and tree lines they use.
items.description: Aerial drone footage at dawn over frosty rolling paddocks. Three deer graze in a paddock seen from directly above, then the drone flies along gullies and tree lines.

items.title: Heat signature in the canopy
items.caption: Looking down through the canopy on thermal: one warm body stands out among cold leaves.
items.description: Grey thermal footage looking down into a eucalypt canopy. A small bright white heat signature moves among the leaves and branches.

items.title: Sambar deer in the forest
items.caption: A sambar deer located in the forest.
items.description: Daylight video looking down on a sambar deer moving through dense green forest undergrowth.

items.title: Kangaroo on the trail camera
items.caption: A kangaroo crossing a bush track mid-morning, caught on a trail camera.
items.description: Colour trail camera footage of a grassy slope among gum trees. A kangaroo hops across the track and out of frame.

items.title: Night visitor on the trail camera
items.caption: A small night visitor on the trail camera at 4:15 am.
items.description: Black-and-white night footage from a trail camera on a bush track; a small animal crosses the bottom of the frame.

items.title: Deer in open pasture
items.caption: Figure 1: Deer observed in open pasture (approx. 5 seconds into flight)
items.alt: Aerial view of a frosty green paddock on a slope, with three light-coloured deer grazing in the open and a timbered edge at the top right.

items.title: Paddock and tree-line interface
items.caption: Figure 2: Typical paddock and tree-line interface (mid-flight)
items.alt: Aerial view of a dense stand of tall eucalypts along a gully, with open paddock and scattered trees and shrubs below it.

items.title: Robert Fitzgerald
items.caption: Robert Fitzgerald, Fitz Feral Hunters.
items.alt: Robert Fitzgerald standing on a grassy Gippsland hillside at sunset in a cap, olive fleece and gloves, binoculars on his chest, beside a spotting scope on a tripod.

items.title: Set up on the hillside
items.caption: Rifle and thermal on the tripod, the ute parked up the slope.
items.alt: A rifle with a thermal scope on a tripod on a grassy slope, with a cream four-wheel drive parked by a fence line above under a clear blue sky.

items.title: On the fence line
items.caption: Set up on the fence line, looking across the gully.
items.alt: A rifle on a carbon tripod beside a timber and wire fence, looking across a treed gully to green hills under a clear sky.
